info.title: Queue OpenAPI for fal-ai/elevenlabs/text-to-voice/design/eleven-v3
info.description: The OpenAPI schema for the fal-ai/elevenlabs/text-to-voice/design/eleven-v3 queue.

loudness.title: Loudness
loudness.description: Controls the volume level of the generated voice. -1 is quietest, 1 is loudest, 0 corresponds to roughly -24 LUFS.

enable_safety_checker.title: Enable Safety Checker
enable_safety_checker.description: Check input content for safety. Disabling requires account authorization.

voice_name.description: Name to use for the saved voice. If omitted, a name is generated automatically.
voice_name.title: Voice Name

output_format.title: Output Format
output_format.description: Output format of the generated audio. Formatted as codec_sample_rate_bitrate.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.description: Description to use for the created voice.
examples: A scary old and haggard witch who is sneaky and menacing. She has a croaky, harsh, shrill, high-pitch voice that cackles.

prompt_strength.description: Controls the balance of prompt versus reference audio when generating voice samples. 0 means almost no prompt influence, 1 means almost no reference audio influence. Only supported when providing reference audio.
prompt_strength.title: Prompt Strength

guidance_scale.title: Guidance Scale
guidance_scale.description: Controls how closely the AI follows the prompt. Lower numbers give the AI more freedom to be creative, while higher numbers force it to stick more to the prompt. High numbers can cause voice to sound artificial or robotic. We recommend to use longer, more detailed prompts at lower Guidance Scale.

audio_url.description: Reference audio to use for the voice generation.
audio_url.title: Audio Url

sync_mode.title: Sync Mode
sync_mode.description: If `True`, the media will be returned as a data URI and the output data won't be available in the request history.

text.description: The text that will be voiced by the created voice. If not provided `auto_generate_text` must be enabled.
text.title: Text

seed.description: Random number that controls the voice generation. Same seed with same inputs produces same voice.
seed.title: Seed

auto_generate_text.title: Auto Generate Text
auto_generate_text.description: Whether to automatically generate a text suitable for the voice description. If text is provided, this field must be disabled.

text.description: The text voiced by the created voice.
text.title: Text
examples: [cackles] Heh heh heh... Well now, what have we here? Lost, little one? Don't you worry your pretty head. I can help you find your way. [short pause] Just a small price to pay, of course. Everything has a price, doesn't it? Come closer, my dear. Let's make a deal. Heh heh heh...

previews.description: A list of audio previews generated with the created voice.
previews.title: Previews

voice_id.description: The ID of the saved voice.
voice_id.title: Voice Id

media_type.description: The media type of the generated audio
media_type.title: Media Type

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the generated audio in seconds
duration_seconds.title: Duration Seconds

generated_voice_id.description: The ID of the generated voice
generated_voice_id.title: Generated Voice Id

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

schema.description: Whether to include logs (`1`) in the response or not (`0`).

success.description: Whether the request was cancelled successfully.
